<new_string>class DraggableBase:
    """
    Helper base class for draggable artists (legend, annotations).

    This class handles the pickling of draggable artists by excluding
    unpicklable references (canvas, cids) and reconnecting them on
    unpickling.
    """

    def __init__(self, ref_artist, use_blit=False):
        self.ref_artist = ref_artist
        self.got_artist = False
        self.canvas = ref_artist.figure.canvas
        cids = [
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("pick_event", self.on_pick),
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("button_release_event", self.on_release),
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("motion_notify_event", self.on_motion),
        ]
        self.cids = cids
        if use_blit:
            self._cachedRenderer = ref_artist.get_agg_filter()
        else:
            self._cachedRenderer = None

    def __getstate__(self):
        state = self.__dict__.copy()
        # Remove unpicklable references
        state.pop('canvas', None)
        state.pop('cids', None)
        return state

    def __setstate__(self, state):
        self.__dict__.update(state)
        # Reconnect to the canvas
        self.canvas = self.ref_artist.figure.canvas
        cids = [
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("pick_event", self.on_pick),
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("button_release_event", self.on_release),
            self.canvas.mpl_connect("motion_notify_event", self.on_motion),
        ]
        self.cids = cids</new_string>
